basic_details.short_information: ICSIL Firemen Recruitment 2026: Intelligent Communication Systems India Ltd. (ICSIL) has announced 3 Firemen vacancies for Dr. D.P. Rastogi Central Research Institute of Homoeopathy (CRIH), Noida, on a contractual outsourced basis. Candidates who have passed Class 12 and have one year of relevant experience can apply online from 22 October 2026 to 25 October 2026 (6:00 PM). Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 22,411. Applicants should check the eligibility criteria, age limit, application fee and selection process before applying.

how_to_apply: Go through the link How to apply for current Jobs which is available on Current Job section under Career tab.
Candidate may apply for any job through ICSIL website only after depositing one time registration fee of Rs. 590/- (non-refundable).
Enter complete details of their Educational Qualification (starting from high School to Highest level of qualification) and experience in their profile.
In order to apply for a post the candidate’s profile must match the eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement for the post.

Update your profile if needed and submit the online application within the window time slot between Opening: 06:00 PM on 22/10/2026 and Closing: 06:00 PM on 25/10/2026. For queries/assistance in this regard, may please contact Front Desk Officer at 011-40538951.
important_instructions: The details of the candidate in the application form must be the same as mentioned in Class 10th Certificate and PAN Card and Aadhar Card. In case the candidate has changed his/her name subsequent to Class 10th, the evidence to that effect should be furnished at the time of interaction/documents verification also. No TA/DA will be provided to candidates for appearing for the interaction/documents verification etc. The place of deployment will be anywhere in Delhi/NCR. They may work in shift(s)/rotational basis as per departmental requirement. No extra conveyance will be paid by ICSIL. Canvassing in any form shall disqualify the candidate. No candidate is permitted to influence the recruitment process by approaching any official of the organization directly or indirectly. ICSIL does not guarantee deployment of all shortlisted candidates. Candidate must keep on watching our ICSIL website (www.icsil.in) for any corrigendum/notification in respect of this vacancy. In case at any stage of recruitment process the documents/information provided by the candidate is found fake or misleading, his/her candidature is liable to be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the post of Firemen on a contractual outsourced basis.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following essential qualifications and experience criteria:

rows.essential_qualification_experience: 1. Should be 12th pass from the recognized board.2. Should have working knowledge of fire safety. Experience: One year experience of fireman in any reputed organization.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive wages of Rs. 22,411/- per month (As per minimum wages notified by Labour Department, GNCT of Delhi). Fifteen (15) days salary to be deducted from the selected candidate as security in two parts i.e. 50% in first month and 50% in second month. This shall be refunded to the candidate with saving bank interest as applicable after comply with following: No Dues certificate is received from the client department, and after completing contractual liabilities with ICSIL as per appointment letter. The engagement is purely on a contractual/outsourced basis for a fixed period or till expiry of contract or till regular incumbents join posts.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: In case number of eligible applicants is disproportionally exceed number of positions, then shortlisting of applicants for interview may be on made on the basis of any criteria as deemed fit and found to be rational. The short listing of candidates for the panel will be based on scrutiny of documents of their age, qualification, experience, etc. and as found eligible as per prescribed criteria and subsequent interaction/interview of the candidate with the department. Candidates must produce original documents in respect of DOB, Qualification and Experience as per eligibility criteria on the date of document verification and interview/interaction; otherwise they will not be allowed to appear in the interview/interaction. Candidates must bring 1 set of photocopies of all relevant documents and 2 photographs.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The details of the candidate in the application form must be the same as mentioned in Class 10th Certificate and PAN Card and Aadhar Card. In case the candidate has changed his/her name subsequent to Class 10th, the evidence to that effect should be furnished at the time of interaction/documents verification also. No TA/DA will be provided to candidates for appearing for the interaction/documents verification etc. The place of deployment will be anywhere in Delhi/NCR. They may work in shift(s)/rotational basis as per departmental requirement. No extra conveyance will be paid by ICSIL. Canvassing in any form shall disqualify the candidate. No candidate is permitted to influence the recruitment process by approaching any official of the organization directly or indirectly. ICSIL does not guarantee deployment of all shortlisted candidates. Candidate must keep on watching our ICSIL website (www.icsil.in) for any corrigendum/notification in respect of this vacancy. In case at any stage of recruitment process the documents/information provided by the candidate is found fake or misleading, his/her candidature is liable to be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in ICSIL Firemen Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Firemen post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online for ICSIL Firemen?
faq.answer: The closing time for online applications is 06:00 PM on 25/10/2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential qualification required for ICSIL Firemen?
faq.answer: Should be 12th pass from the recognized board, should have working knowledge of fire safety, and One year experience of fireman in any reputed organization.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ICSIL Firemen posts?
faq.answer: 30 years and below on the date of Interview (Can be relaxed upto 35 years for those having minimum experience of one year with central government of its Organizations).

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary for ICSIL Firemen?
faq.answer: Rs. 22,411/- (Per Month) (As per minimum wages notified by Labour Department, GNCT of Delhi).

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for ICSIL Firemen?
faq.answer: Candidate may apply for any job through ICSIL website only after depositing one time registration fee of Rs. 590/- (non-refundable).

faq.question: Q7. Where will the selected candidates be deployed?
faq.answer: The place of deployment will be anywhere in Delhi/NCR. They may work in shift(s)/rotational basis as per departmental requirement.
